body.label: Trigger
body.html: An enemy enters a space adjacent to you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move 1 unit without triggering Reactions. The triggering enemy becomes Exposed if it follows you this turn.

surges.html: Any movement from this Reaction ignores Reactions caused by leaving reach or cover.
After the triggering effect resolves, learn whether its source has any unused Reactions or maintained effects.
